owner.name: Owner
owner.text: Full access, including editing Company Settings. It also owns two sibling companies, so it is the only account with the company switcher.

admin.name: Admin
admin.text: Confirms or rejects what we read, edits or deletes any company document, and sees Company Settings read-only.

user.name: User
user.text: Uploads documents and edits their own. Keeps private files in Only me. Cannot confirm or delete company documents.

user1.name: User 1
user1.text: Same role as User. Sign in as two users to see that one person's files, and private files, stay theirs.

user2.name: User 2
user2.text: Same role as User. Sign in as two users to see that one person's files, and private files, stay theirs.

viewer.name: Viewer
viewer.text: Read-only. Sees filed documents, the Calendar and Search, but cannot upload, edit, or see what is waiting for review.

capture.title: Capture

remember.title: Remember
remember.text: Nothing gets lost. Everything stays one search away.
